## Framing
Phase 6 = deliberate MINIMAL vertical slice BEFORE reconciliation engine (P8), parsing (P7),
portal (P11), API/exports (P14), web (P15). Falsify design on one real jurisdiction. Build
purpose-built minimal count-reconciliation (§29.1) + dossier renderer (§39.2), J-1 acceptance
query, hardness-precondition record (BEFORE slice), committed retrospective. Minimal; P15.2
supersedes dossier renderer. Do NOT gold-plate. reconcile/api/exports/inference/tasks = skeletons.

## Requirements
- [ ] R1 slice jurisdiction end-to-end: assets, orgs, deployment, contract, portal/records config, >=1 real contradiction rendered without collapse
- [ ] R2 J-1 end to end (SIG-CHART-009); every material fact -> doc at locator
- [ ] R3 distinct count predicates; PREDICATE_CONFLATION on deliberate conflation; deltas -> research tasks (RECON-026/028/029)
- [ ] R4 dossier §39.2 contract (section order; what-we-dont-know in summary/print/API; incompleteness banner; print/PDF; figures expandable to reconciliation) (UI-010..014)

- [ ] R6 hardness precondition declared BEFORE slice

## SLICE JURISDICTION (declared before slice): Oklahoma City, OK — OKCPD Flock ALPR (Master Agreement C241032)
Verified real facts (multiple outlets, as of 2026-09-01):
- contracted_device_count=90 (Master Agreement C241032, $270k/yr, since 2023) R1·D1 IMMUTABLE
- active_device_count=90 (Chief Bacy / City Mgr Freeman renewal memo, 2026-08) R2·D1
- mapped_device_count=299 (DeFlock community map, metro) R5·D3 lower bound
- claimed count DISAGREE (within-predicate): DeFlock ~299/300 vs Bacy ~190 (90 police + ~100 business, city limits) 2026-08-18
- installed/invoiced = not_researched (what we don't know)
- Contradictions: (C1) policy_configuration_divergence OKCPD Ops Manual §5-118 "will not be shared as part of a law enforcement information database" vs 109 agencies national sharing; (C2) value_disagreement claimed count 299 vs 190; (C3) retention 30d (manual/vendor default) vs 7d (post-renewal amendment)
- PREDICATE_CONFLATION deliberate: reconcile contracted 90 vs mapped 299 as one predicate -> fires
- lifecycle transition (dated): council renewal 2026-08-18 (5-3; retention 30->7; federal-sharing amendment; through 2027-06-30)
- asset no operator: DeFlock-mapped ALPR poles, operator unknown (~100 business/HOA + unattributed)
- authorization: council vote 2026-08-18 5-3, public comment taken (2200+ sigs), NOT consent agenda
- legal_regime: 47 O.S. §7-606.1; OKCPD Ops Manual §5-118; next_decision_date 2027-06-30
Source families (>=3): F1 executed contract/procurement (R1); F2 municipal governance/council (R2); F3 DeFlock community map (R5/OSM); F4 investigative journalism JournalRecord/Oklahoman/KGOU/News9/Forbes/IPVM (R4); F5 OKCPD Ops Manual §5-118 (R2); F6 statute 47 O.S. §7-606.1 (R1).
